summary: Verified 'Remember this device for 30 days' feature end-to-end. Backend: pytest suite (test_device_limits.py + test_user_sessions.py + test_auth_cookies_csrf.py + new test_remember_device_e2e.py) => 16 passed, 3 skipped (pre-existing demo-seed skips). Live-URL E2E confirmed: default remember_device=True counts session, remember_device=False returns action='allow_ephemeral', ephemeral=true, does NOT increment device-limit count across 5 consecutive ephemeral logins, and cookie Max-Age differs (2592000 for remembered, 28800 for ephemeral). Frontend: checkbox present at data-testid='login-remember-device', default-checked=true, copy toggles correctly ('Stays signed in...Counts toward...' ↔ 'Ephemeral session — signs out in 8 hours and does NOT use a device slot...'). End-to-end ephemeral login as dltest@example.com landed on /patients and Sessions page (/settings/security) renders 16 session-ephemeral-<sid> amber pills reading 'EPHEMERAL'. Chip 'sessions-device-cap-chip' displays '13/2 · BASIC'.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie Max-Age is exposed via Set-Cookie headers on plain HTTP responses (public URL) — verified via requests library that the correct 2592000 vs 28800 values are set based on the remember_device flag. Good.
Backward compat handled correctly: legacy sessions without remember_device field are treated as True via {$ne: False} filter — verified by counting active sessions still working on dltest user.
seed_data_creation: none — used existing dltest user; test created additional session rows on the user via multiple logins
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully working. dltest user now has many session rows (13+) accumulated from the E2E tests; cap remains 2 (BASIC), so future device-limit tests will hit 'warn' action, not 'allow', on the first remembered login. Frontend Sessions UI is at /settings/security (not /settings/sessions). Playwright selectors confirmed: data-testid='login-remember-device', 'login-remember-device-row', 'login-email-input', 'login-password-input', 'login-submit-button', 'sessions-device-cap-chip', 'session-ephemeral-<sid>'.
